title: Bee Removal in Amityville, Long Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Amityville, Long Island. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, attics, and eaves. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional stinging insect removal throughout Amityville, Long Island — treating wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nests that threaten homes and businesses. Our licensed technicians locate nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, eaves, and wooden structures, treat the colony, remove accessible nest material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization. Whether you're dealing with an aggressive yellow jacket nest in a wall cavity or carpenter bees drilling into your trim, we deliver fast, effective solutions.
whyUs: Our Amityville bee removal specialists combine over 15 years of local experience with eco-friendly removal techniques that protect both your property and the environment. We offer transparent pricing between $350 and $550, same-day emergency service, and a satisfaction guarantee that has made us Long Island's most trusted pest control provider.
localContext: Amityville's charming historic homes along Broadway and the waterfront properties near the Great South Bay provide ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets seeking shelter in eaves, soffits, chimneys, and older wood structures. From the tree-lined streets of the Village to newer developments near Sunrise Highway, carpenter bees find untreated wood trim and fascia, while yellow jackets nest in wall voids and underground burrows. Our team understands the unique stinging insect pressure facing Amityville residents and responds quickly to protect your family and property.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Amityville?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest in Amityville?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency service throughout Amityville and Long Island. Most nest treatments are completed within 1–3 hours, and we can typically arrive at your property within 2–4 hours of your call during business hours.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Amityville?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets come back after treatment?
faqs.answer: After treating the nest, we locate and seal every entry point the insects were using, which prevents recolonization of that site. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
